</section><section data-mw-section-id="24" id="mwBBw" aria-labelledby="Physical_AI"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Physical_AI">Physical AI</h3></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt528" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBB0" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Main&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Main&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Physical artificial intelligence&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt529" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt528" id="mwBB4">Main article: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physical_artificial_intelligence" title="Physical artificial intelligence">Physical artificial intelligence</a></div>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="25" id="mwBB8" aria-labelledby="Health_and_medicine"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Health_and_medicine">Health and medicine</h3></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt530" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBCA" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Main&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Main&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Artificial intelligence in healthcare&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt531" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt530" id="mwBCE">Main article: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence_in_healthcare" title="Artificial intelligence in healthcare">Artificial intelligence in healthcare</a></div>

<p id="mwBCI"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaFold_2" title="AlphaFold 2" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBCM">AlphaFold 2</a> (2021) demonstrated the ability to approximate, in hours rather than months, the 3D <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protein_structure" title="Protein structure" id="mwBCQ">structure of a protein</a>.<sup about="#mwt534" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-149" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-149&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-149" id="mwBCU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBCY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCc">[</span>137<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCg">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2023, it was reported that AI-guided drug discovery helped find a class of antibiotics capable of killing two different types of drug-resistant bacteria.<sup about="#mwt537" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-150" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-150&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-150" id="mwBCk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBCo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCs">[</span>138<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCw">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2024, researchers used machine learning to accelerate the search for <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parkinson's_disease" title="Parkinson's disease" id="mwBC0">Parkinson's disease</a> drug treatments. Their aim was to identify compounds that block the clumping, or aggregation, of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpha-synuclein" title="Alpha-synuclein" id="mwBC4">alpha-synuclein</a> (the protein that characterises Parkinson's disease). They were able to speed up the initial screening process ten-fold and reduce the cost by a thousand-fold.<sup about="#mwt540" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-151" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-151&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-151" id="mwBC8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBDA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBDE">[</span>139<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBDI">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt543" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-152" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-152&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-152" id="mwBDM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBDQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBDU">[</span>140<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBDY">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBDc">AI is increasingly being used in medical diagnostics, including the detection of diseases such as lung cancer from medical imaging like <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CT_scan" title="CT scan" id="mwBDg">CT scans</a>. <sup about="#mwt546" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-153" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-153&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-153" id="mwBDk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBDo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBDs">[</span>141<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBDw">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBD0">A 2026 <i id="mwBD4"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nature_(journal)" title="Nature (journal)" id="mwBD8">Nature</a></i> article titled "Dozens of AI disease-prediction models were trained on dubious data" highlighted the use of unreliable data being used to train AI medical prediction models for <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stroke" title="Stroke" id="mwBEA">stroke</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diabetes" title="Diabetes" id="mwBEE">diabetes</a> in 125 research articles. Evidence suggested some of the AI tools that were developed on unreliable data had been used on patients, although it was not clear if there were adverse outcomes.<sup about="#mwt549" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-154" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-154&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-154" id="mwBEI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBEM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBEQ">[</span>142<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBEU">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt552" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-155" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-155&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-155" id="mwBEY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBEc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBEg">[</span>143<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBEk">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="26" id="mwBEo" aria-labelledby="Gaming"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Gaming">Gaming</h3></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt553" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBEs" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Main&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Main&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Artificial intelligence in video games&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt554" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt553" id="mwBEw">Main article: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence_in_video_games" title="Artificial intelligence in video games">Artificial intelligence in video games</a></div>

<p id="mwBE0"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Game_AI" title="Game AI" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBE4">Game playing</a> programs have been used since the 1950s to demonstrate and test AI's most advanced techniques.<sup about="#mwt557" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-156" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-156&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-156" id="mwBE8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBFA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBFE">[</span>144<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBFI">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IBM_Deep_Blue" title="IBM Deep Blue" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBFM">Deep Blue</a> became the first computer chess-playing system to beat a reigning world chess champion, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garry_Kasparov" title="Garry Kasparov" id="mwBFQ">Garry Kasparov</a>, on 11 May 1997.<sup about="#mwt560" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-157" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-157&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-157" id="mwBFU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBFY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBFc">[</span>145<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBFg">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2011, in a <i id="mwBFk"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeopardy!" title="Jeopardy!" id="mwBFo">Jeopardy!</a></i> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quiz_show" title="Quiz show" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBFs">quiz show</a> exhibition match, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IBM" title="IBM" id="mwBFw">IBM</a>'s <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Question_answering_system" title="Question answering system" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBF0">question answering system</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Watson_(artificial_intelligence_software)" title="Watson (artificial intelligence software)" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBF4">Watson</a>, defeated the two greatest <i id="mwBF8">Jeopardy!</i> champions, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brad_Rutter" title="Brad Rutter" id="mwBGA">Brad Rutter</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ken_Jennings" title="Ken Jennings" id="mwBGE">Ken Jennings</a>, by a significant margin.<sup about="#mwt563" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-158" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-158&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-158" id="mwBGI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBGM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBGQ">[</span>146<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBGU">]</span></span></a></sup> In March 2016, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaGo" title="AlphaGo" id="mwBGY">AlphaGo</a> won 4 out of 5 games of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(game)" title="Go (game)" id="mwBGc">Go</a> in a match with Go champion <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lee_Sedol" title="Lee Sedol" id="mwBGg">Lee Sedol</a>, becoming the first <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Computer_Go" title="Computer Go" id="mwBGk">computer Go</a>-playing system to beat a professional Go player without <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_handicaps" title="Go handicaps" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBGo">handicaps</a>. Then, in 2017, it <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaGo_versus_Ke_Jie" title="AlphaGo versus Ke Jie" id="mwBGs">defeated Ke Jie</a>, who was the best Go player in the world.<sup about="#mwt566" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-159" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-159&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-159" id="mwBGw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBG0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBG4">[</span>147<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBG8">]</span></span></a></sup> Other programs handle <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperfect_information" title="Imperfect information" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBHA">imperfect-information</a> games, such as the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poker" title="Poker" id="mwBHE">poker</a>-playing program <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pluribus_(poker_bot)" title="Pluribus (poker bot)" id="mwBHI">Pluribus</a>.<sup about="#mwt569" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-160" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-160&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-160" id="mwBHM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBHQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBHU">[</span>148<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBHY">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepMind" title="DeepMind" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBHc">DeepMind</a> developed increasingly generalistic <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reinforcement_learning" title="Reinforcement learning" id="mwBHg">reinforcement learning</a> models, such as with <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MuZero" title="MuZero" id="mwBHk">MuZero</a>, which could be trained to play chess, Go, or <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atari" title="Atari" id="mwBHo">Atari</a> games.<sup about="#mwt572" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-161" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-161&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-161" id="mwBHs"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBHw"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBH0">[</span>149<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBH4">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2019, DeepMind's AlphaStar achieved grandmaster level in <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/StarCraft_II" title="StarCraft II" id="mwBH8">StarCraft II</a>, a particularly challenging real-time strategy game that involves incomplete knowledge of what happens on the map.<sup about="#mwt575" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-162" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-162&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-162" id="mwBIA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBIE"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBII">[</span>150<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBIM">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2021, an AI agent competed in a PlayStation <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gran_Turismo_(series)" title="Gran Turismo (series)" id="mwBIQ">Gran Turismo</a> competition, winning against four of the world's best Gran Turismo drivers using deep reinforcement learning.<sup about="#mwt578" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-163" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-163&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-163" id="mwBIU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBIY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBIc">[</span>151<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBIg">]</span></span></a></sup> In 2024, Google DeepMind introduced SIMA, a type of AI capable of autonomously playing nine previously unseen <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open-world" title="Open-world" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBIk">open-world</a> video games by observing screen output, as well as executing short, specific tasks in response to natural language instructions.<sup about="#mwt581" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-164" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-164&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-164" id="mwBIo"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBIs"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBIw">[</span>152<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBI0">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="27" id="mwBI4" aria-labelledby="Mathematics"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Mathematics">Mathematics</h3></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt582" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBI8" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;See also&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:See_also&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;AlphaDev&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt583" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt582" id="mwBJA">See also: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaDev" title="AlphaDev">AlphaDev</a></div>
<p id="mwBJE">In mathematics, probabilistic large language models are versatile, but can also produce wrong answers in the form of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hallucination_(artificial_intelligence)" title="Hallucination (artificial intelligence)" id="mwBJI">hallucinations</a>. The <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alibaba_Group" title="Alibaba Group" id="mwBJM">Alibaba Group</a> developed a version of its <i id="mwBJQ"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qwen" title="Qwen" id="mwBJU">Qwen</a></i> models called <i id="mwBJY">Qwen2-Math</i>, that achieved state-of-the-art performance on several mathematical benchmarks, including 84% accuracy on the MATH dataset of competition mathematics problems.<sup about="#mwt586" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-VentureBeat_8_August_2024_165-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;VentureBeat 8 August 2024&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-VentureBeat_8_August_2024-165&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-VentureBeat_8_August_2024-165" id="mwBJc"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBJg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBJk">[</span>153<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBJo">]</span></span></a></sup> In January 2025, Microsoft proposed the technique <i id="mwBJs">rStar-Math</i> that leverages <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Carlo_tree_search" title="Monte Carlo tree search" id="mwBJw">Monte Carlo tree search</a> and step-by-step reasoning, enabling a relatively small language model like <i id="mwBJ0">Qwen-7B</i> to solve 53% of the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Invitational_Mathematics_Examination" title="American Invitational Mathematics Examination" id="mwBJ4">AIME</a> 2024 and 90% of the MATH benchmark problems.<sup about="#mwt589" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-166" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-166&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-166" id="mwBJ8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBKA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBKE">[</span>154<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBKI">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_DeepMind" title="Google DeepMind" id="mwBKM">Google DeepMind</a> has developed models for solving mathematical problems: <i id="mwBKQ"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaTensor" title="AlphaTensor" id="mwBKU">AlphaTensor</a></i>, <i id="mwBKY"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaGeometry" title="AlphaGeometry" id="mwBKc">AlphaGeometry</a></i>, <i id="mwBKg">AlphaProof</i>, <i id="mwBKk"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaEvolve" title="AlphaEvolve" id="mwBKo">AlphaEvolve</a>, and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FunSearch" title="FunSearch" id="mwBKs">FunSearch</a>.</i><sup about="#mwt592" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-167" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-167&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-167" id="mwBKw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBK0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBK4">[</span>155<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBK8">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt595" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-168" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-168&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-168" id="mwBLA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBLE"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBLI">[</span>156<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBLM">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBLQ">When natural language is used to describe mathematical problems, converters can transform such prompts into a formal language such as <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lean_(proof_assistant)" title="Lean (proof assistant)" id="mwBLU">Lean</a> to define mathematical tasks. The experimental model <i id="mwBLY">Gemini Deep Think</i> accepts natural language prompts directly and achieved gold medal results in the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Math_Olympiad" title="International Math Olympiad" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBLc">International Math Olympiad</a> of 2025.<sup about="#mwt598" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-169" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-169&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-169" id="mwBLg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBLk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBLo">[</span>157<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBLs">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBLw"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topological_deep_learning" title="Topological deep learning" id="mwBL0">Topological deep learning</a> integrates various <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topological" title="Topological" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBL4">topological</a> approaches.</p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="28" id="mwBL8" aria-labelledby="Finance"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Finance">Finance</h3></div>

<p id="mwBMA">According to Nicolas Firzli, director of the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Pensions_&amp;_Investments_Forum" title="World Pensions &amp; Investments Forum" id="mwBME">World Pensions &amp; Investments Forum</a>, it may be too early to see the emergence of highly innovative AI-informed financial products and services. He argues that "the deployment of AI tools will simply further automatise things: destroying tens of thousands of jobs in banking, financial planning, and pension advice in the process, but I'm not sure it will unleash a new wave of [e.g., sophisticated] pension innovation."<sup about="#mwt600" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-170" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-170&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-170" id="mwBMI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBMM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBMQ">[</span>158<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBMU">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="29" id="mwBMY" aria-labelledby="Military"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Military">Military</h3></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt601" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBMc" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;main&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Main&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Military applications of artificial intelligence&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt602" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt601" id="mwBMg">Main article: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Military_applications_of_artificial_intelligence" title="Military applications of artificial intelligence">Military applications of artificial intelligence</a></div>

<p id="mwBMk">Various countries are deploying AI military applications.<sup about="#mwt605" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-CRS-2019_171-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;CRS-2019&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-CRS-2019-171&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-CRS-2019-171" id="mwBMo"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBMs"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBMw">[</span>159<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBM0">]</span></span></a></sup> The main applications enhance <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Command_and_control" title="Command and control" id="mwBM4">command and control</a>, communications, sensors, integration and interoperability.<sup about="#mwt608" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Slyusar-2019_172-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Slyusar-2019&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-Slyusar-2019-172&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Slyusar-2019-172" id="mwBM8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBNA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBNE">[</span>160<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBNI">]</span></span></a></sup> Research is targeting intelligence collection and analysis, logistics, cyber operations, information operations, and semiautonomous and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicular_automation" title="Vehicular automation" id="mwBNM">autonomous vehicles</a>.<sup about="#mwt609" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-CRS-2019_171-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;CRS-2019&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-CRS-2019-171" id="mwBNQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBNU"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBNY">[</span>159<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBNc">]</span></span></a></sup> AI technologies enable coordination of sensors and effectors, threat detection and identification, marking of enemy positions, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Target_acquisition" title="Target acquisition" id="mwBNg">target acquisition</a>, coordination and deconfliction of distributed <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forward_observers_in_the_U.S._military" title="Forward observers in the U.S. military" id="mwBNk">Joint Fires</a> between networked combat vehicles, both human-operated and autonomous.<sup about="#mwt610" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Slyusar-2019_172-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Slyusar-2019&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Slyusar-2019-172" id="mwBNo"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBNs"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBNw">[</span>160<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBN0">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBN4">AI has been used in military operations in Iraq, Syria, Israel and Ukraine.<sup about="#mwt611" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-CRS-2019_171-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;CRS-2019&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-CRS-2019-171" id="mwBN8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBOA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBOE">[</span>159<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBOI">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt614" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-173" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-173&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-173" id="mwBOM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBOQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBOU">[</span>161<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBOY">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt617" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Davies-2023_174-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Davies-2023&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-Davies-2023-174&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Davies-2023-174" id="mwBOc"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBOg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBOk">[</span>162<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBOo">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt620" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-175" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-175&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-175" id="mwBOs"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBOw"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBO0">[</span>163<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBO4">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="30" id="mwBO8" aria-labelledby="Generative_AI"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Generative_AI">Generative AI</h3></div>
<div class="excerpt-block" about="#mwt621" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBPA" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Excerpt&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Excerpt&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Generative artificial intelligence&quot;},&quot;only&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;paragraphs&quot;},&quot;paragraphs&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1-3&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><span class="mw-empty-elt"><style data-mw-deduplicate="TemplateStyles:r1353838603" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" about="#mwt622" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Excerpt/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}">.mw-parser-output .excerpt-hat .mw-editsection-like{font-style:normal}</style><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt623" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable dablink excerpt-hat selfref">These paragraphs are an excerpt from <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_AI" title="Generative AI">Generative AI</a>.<span class="mw-editsection-like plainlinks"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a rel="mw:ExtLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Generative_AI&amp;action=edit" class="external text" data-mw-original-href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Generative_AI&amp;action=edit">edit</a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div><div class="excerpt">
<p><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_AI" title="Generative AI">Generative artificial intelligence</a> (GenAI) is a subfield of artificial intelligence (AI) that uses <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_model" title="Generative model">generative models</a> to generate text, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_image" title="Digital image">images</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_video" title="Digital video">videos</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_audio" title="Digital audio">audio</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_code" title="Software code" class="mw-redirect">software code</a> or other forms of data.<sup about="#mwt626" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-176" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-176&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-176" id="mwBPE"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBPI"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBPM">[</span>164<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBPQ">]</span></span></a></sup> These models <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning" title="Machine learning">learn the underlying patterns</a> and structures of their <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Training_data" title="Training data" class="mw-redirect">training data</a>, and use them to generate new data<sup about="#mwt631" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-177" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-177&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-177" id="mwBPU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBPY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBPc">[</span>165<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBPg">]</span></span></a></sup> in response to input, which often takes the form of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_language" title="Natural language">natural language</a> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prompt_engineering" title="Prompt engineering">prompts</a>.<sup about="#mwt636" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Generative_AI_nytimes2_178-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Generative AI nytimes2&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-Generative_AI_nytimes2-178&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Generative_AI_nytimes2-178" id="mwBPk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBPo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBPs">[</span>166<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBPw">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt641" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Generative_AI_bloomberg2_179-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Generative AI bloomberg2&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-Generative_AI_bloomberg2-179&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Generative_AI_bloomberg2-179" id="mwBP0"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBP4"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBP8">[</span>167<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBQA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p>The prevalence of generative AI tools has increased significantly since the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_boom" title="AI boom">AI boom</a> in the 2020s. This boom was made possible by improvements in <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deep_learning" title="Deep learning">deep</a> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neural_network_(machine_learning)" title="Neural network (machine learning)">neural networks</a>, particularly <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model" title="Large language model">large language models</a> (LLMs), which are based on the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(machine_learning_model)" title="Transformer (machine learning model)" class="mw-redirect">transformer</a> architecture. Generative AI <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applications_of_artificial_intelligence" title="Applications of artificial intelligence">applications</a> include <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chatbots" title="Chatbots" class="mw-redirect">chatbots</a> such as <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT" title="ChatGPT">ChatGPT</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_(language_model)" title="Claude (language model)" class="mw-redirect">Claude</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft_Copilot" title="Microsoft Copilot">Microsoft Copilot</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek_(chatbot)" title="DeepSeek (chatbot)">DeepSeek</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doubao" title="Doubao">Doubao</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gemini_(chatbot)" title="Gemini (chatbot)" class="mw-redirect">Google Gemini</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grok_(chatbot)" title="Grok (chatbot)">Grok</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimi_(AI)" title="Kimi (AI)">Kimi</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qwen" title="Qwen">Qwen</a>; <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Text-to-image" title="Text-to-image" class="mw-redirect">text-to-image</a> models such as <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DALL-E" title="DALL-E">DALL-E</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adobe_Firefly" title="Adobe Firefly">Firefly</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stable_Diffusion" title="Stable Diffusion">Stable Diffusion</a>, and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midjourney" title="Midjourney">Midjourney</a>; and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Text-to-video" title="Text-to-video" class="mw-redirect">text-to-video</a> models such as <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Veo_(text-to-video_model)" title="Veo (text-to-video model)">Veo</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LTX-2" title="LTX-2" class="mw-redirect">LTX</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sora_(text-to-video_model)" title="Sora (text-to-video model)">Sora</a>.<sup about="#mwt646" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-180" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-180&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-180" id="mwBQE"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBQI"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBQM">[</span>168<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBQQ">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt651" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-181" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-181&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-181" id="mwBQU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBQY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBQc">[</span>169<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBQg">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt656" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Generative_AI_Metz-2024_182-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Generative AI Metz-2024&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-Generative_AI_Metz-2024-182&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Generative_AI_Metz-2024-182" id="mwBQk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBQo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBQs">[</span>170<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBQw">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p>Companies in a variety of sectors have used generative AI, including those in software development, healthcare,<sup about="#mwt661" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-183" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-183&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-183" class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBRY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBRc">[</span>173<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBRg">]</span></span></a></sup> customer service,<sup about="#mwt676" class="mw-ref data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-186&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-186" id="mwBRk"><span </section><section data-mw-section-id="31" id="mwBSk" aria-labelledby="Agents"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Agents">Agents</h3></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt694" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBSo" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Main&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Main&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Agentic AI&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt695" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt694" id="mwBSs">Main article: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agentic_AI" title="Agentic AI" class="mw-redirect">Agentic AI</a></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt696" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBSw" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;See also&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:See_also&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;OpenClaw&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;CrewAI&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt697" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt696" id="mwBS0">See also: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenClaw" title="OpenClaw">OpenClaw</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CrewAI" title="CrewAI">CrewAI</a></div>

<p id="mwBS4">AI agents are software entities designed to perceive their environment, make decisions, and take actions autonomously to achieve specific goals. These agents can interact with users, their environment, or other agents. AI agents are used in various applications, including <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virtual_assistant" title="Virtual assistant" id="mwBS8">virtual assistants</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chatbots" title="Chatbots" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBTA">chatbots</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autonomous_vehicles" title="Autonomous vehicles" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBTE">autonomous vehicles</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game_console" title="Video game console" id="mwBTI">game-playing systems</a>, and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industrial_robotics" title="Industrial robotics" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBTM">industrial robotics</a>. AI agents operate within the constraints of their programming, available computational resources, and hardware limitations. This means they are restricted to performing tasks within their defined scope and have finite memory and processing capabilities. In real-world applications, AI agents often face time constraints for decision-making and action execution. Many AI agents incorporate learning algorithms, enabling them to improve their performance over time through experience or training. Using machine learning, AI agents can adapt to new situations and optimise their behaviour for their designated tasks.<sup about="#mwt700" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-190" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-190&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-190" id="mwBTQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBTU"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBTY">[</span>178<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBTc">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt703" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-191" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-191&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-191" id="mwBTg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBTk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBTo">[</span>179<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBTs">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt706" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-192" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-192&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-192" id="mwBTw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBT0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBT4">[</span>180<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBT8">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="32" id="mwBUA" aria-labelledby="Web_search"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Web_search">Web search</h3></div>
<p id="mwBUE"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft" title="Microsoft" id="mwBUI">Microsoft</a> introduced <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft_Copilot" title="Microsoft Copilot" id="mwBUM">Copilot Search</a> in February 2023 under the name <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bing_Chat" title="Bing Chat" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBUQ">Bing Chat</a>. Copilot Search provides AI-generated summaries.<sup about="#mwt709" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-193" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-193&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-193" id="mwBUU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBUY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBUc">[</span>181<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBUg">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBUk"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_AI" title="Generative AI" id="mwBUo">Generative AI</a> features added to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Search" title="Google Search" id="mwBUs">Google Search</a> include <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_Overviews" title="AI Overviews" id="mwBUw">AI Overviews</a> in May 2024<sup about="#mwt712" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-194" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-194&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-194" id="mwBU0"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBU4"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBU8">[</span>182<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBVA">]</span></span></a></sup> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_Mode" title="AI Mode" id="mwBVE">AI Mode</a> in May 2025.<sup about="#mwt715" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-195" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-195&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-195" id="mwBVI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBVM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBVQ">[</span>183<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBVU">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="33" id="mwBVY" aria-labelledby="Sexuality"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Sexuality">Sexuality</h3></div>

<p id="mwBVc">Applications of AI in this domain include AI-enabled menstruation and fertility trackers that analyse user data to offer predictions,<sup about="#mwt718" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-196" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-196&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-196" id="mwBVg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBVk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBVo">[</span>184<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBVs">]</span></span></a></sup> AI-integrated sex toys (e.g., <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teledildonics" title="Teledildonics" id="mwBVw">teledildonics</a>),<sup about="#mwt721" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-197" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-197&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-197" id="mwBV0"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBV4"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBV8">[</span>185<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBWA">]</span></span></a></sup> AI-generated sexual education content,<sup about="#mwt724" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-198" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-198&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-198" id="mwBWE"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBWI"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBWM">[</span>186<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBWQ">]</span></span></a></sup> and AI agents that simulate sexual and romantic partners (e.g., <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Replika" title="Replika" id="mwBWU">Replika</a>).<sup about="#mwt727" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-199" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-199&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-199" id="mwBWY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBWc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBWg">[</span>187<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBWk">]</span></span></a></sup> AI is also used for the production of non-consensual <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deepfake_pornography" title="Deepfake pornography" id="mwBWo">deepfake pornography</a>, raising significant ethical and legal concerns.<sup about="#mwt730" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-200" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-200&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-200" id="mwBWs"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBWw"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBW0">[</span>188<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBW4">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBW8">AI technologies have also been used to attempt to identify <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Online_gender-based_violence" title="Online gender-based violence" id="mwBXA">online gender-based violence</a> and online <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sexual_grooming" title="Sexual grooming" id="mwBXE">sexual grooming</a> of minors.<sup about="#mwt733" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-201" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-201&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-201" id="mwBXI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBXM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBXQ">[</span>189<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBXU">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt736" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-202" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-202&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-202" id="mwBXY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBXc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBXg">[</span>190<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBXk">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="34" id="mwBXo" aria-labelledby="Other_industry-specific_tasks"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Other_industry-specific_tasks">Other industry-specific tasks</h3></div>
<p id="mwBXs">In a 2017 survey, one in five companies reported having incorporated "AI" in some offerings or processes.<sup about="#mwt739" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-203" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-203&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-203" id="mwBXw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBX0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBX4">[</span>191<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBX8">]</span></span></a></sup></p> 

<p id="mwBYA">In the field of evacuation and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disaster" title="Disaster" id="mwBYE">disaster</a> management, AI has been used to investigate patterns in large-scale and small-scale evacuations using historical data from GPS, videos or social media.<sup about="#mwt742" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-204" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-204&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-204" id="mwBYI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBYM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBYQ">[</span>192<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBYU">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt745" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-205" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-205&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-205" id="mwBYY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBYc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBYg">[</span>193<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBYk">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt748" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-206" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-206&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-206" id="mwBYo"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBYs"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBYw">[</span>194<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBY0">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBY4">During the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Indian_general_election" title="2024 Indian general election" id="mwBY8">2024 Indian elections</a>, US$50 million was spent on authorised AI-generated content, notably by creating <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deepfake" title="Deepfake" id="mwBZA">deepfakes</a> of allied (including sometimes deceased) politicians to better engage with voters, and by translating speeches to various local languages.<sup about="#mwt751" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-207" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-207&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-207" id="mwBZE"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBZI"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBZM">[</span>195<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBZQ">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBZU">The use of generative AI by law firms for legal research resulted in the creation of the global "AI Hallucination Cases" database, in April 2025, established by <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HEC_Paris" title="HEC Paris" id="mwBZY">HEC Paris</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sciences_Po" title="Sciences Po" id="mwBZc">Sciences Po</a> legal data analysis lecturer Damien Charlotin.<sup about="#mwt754" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-208" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-208&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-208" id="mwBZg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBZk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBZo">[</span>196<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBZs">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt757" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-209" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-209&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-209" id="mwBZw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBZ0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBZ4">[</span>197<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBZ8">]</span></span></a></sup> By 2026, judges had issued sanctions and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_association" title="Bar association" id="mwBaA">bar associations</a> had issued warnings due to attorney submissions to the courts containing fabricated case law citations <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hallucination_(artificial_intelligence)" title="Hallucination (artificial intelligence)" id="mwBaE">hallucinated</a> by AI tools.<sup about="#mwt760" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-210" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-210&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-210" id="mwBaI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBaM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBaQ">[</span>198<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBaU">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt761" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBaY" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;See also&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:See_also&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Hallucination (artificial intelligence)#In legal filings&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt762" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt761" id="mwBac">See also: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hallucination_(artificial_intelligence)#In_legal_filings" title="Hallucination (artificial intelligence)">Hallucination (artificial intelligence) §<span typeof="mw:Entity">&nbsp;</span>In legal filings</a></div>

for serious problems: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demis_Hassabis" title="Demis Hassabis" id="mwBb0">Demis Hassabis</a> of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" <section data-mw-section-id="36" id="mwBc8" aria-labelledby="Risks_and_harm"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Risks_and_harm">Risks and harm</h3></div>
<section data-mw-section-id="37" id="mwBdA" aria-labelledby="Privacy_and_copyright"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading4"><h4 id="Privacy_and_copyright">Privacy and copyright</h4></div>
<span class="mw-empty-elt" about="#mwt786" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBdE" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Further&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Further&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Information privacy&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Artificial intelligence and copyright&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1368532237" about="#mwt787" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;templatestyles&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;Module:Hatnote/styles.css&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;extsrc&quot;:&quot;&quot;}}"></span><div role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable" about="#mwt786" id="mwBdI">Further information: <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Information_privacy" title="Information privacy">Information privacy</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence_and_copyright" title="Artificial intelligence and copyright">Artificial intelligence and copyright</a></div>

<p id="mwBdM">Machine learning algorithms require large amounts of data. The techniques used to acquire this data have raised concerns about <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Privacy" title="Privacy" id="mwBdQ">privacy</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveillance" title="Surveillance" id="mwBdU">surveillance</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copyright" title="Copyright" id="mwBdY">copyright</a>.</p>

<!-- PRIVACY PROBLEM -->
<p id="mwBdc">AI-powered devices and services, such as virtual assistants and IoT products, continuously collect personal information, raising concerns about intrusive data gathering and unauthorised access by third parties. The loss of privacy is further exacerbated by AI's ability to process and combine vast amounts of data, potentially leading to a surveillance society where individual activities are constantly monitored and analysed without adequate safeguards or transparency.</p>

<p id="mwBdg">Sensitive user data collected may include online activity records, geolocation data, video, or audio.<sup about="#mwt788" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEGAO2022_218-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEGAO2022&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEGAO2022-218&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Sfnp&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfnp&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;GAO&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2022&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGAO2022-218" id="mwBdk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBdo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBds">[</span>206<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBdw">]</span></span></a></sup> For example, in order to build <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speech_recognition" title="Speech recognition" id="mwBd0">speech recognition</a> algorithms, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_(company)" title="Amazon (company)" id="mwBd4">Amazon</a> has recorded millions of private conversations and allowed <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Temporary_worker" title="Temporary worker" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBd8">temporary workers</a> to listen to and transcribe some of them.<sup about="#mwt791" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEValinsky2019_219-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEValinsky2019&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEValinsky2019-219&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Sfnp&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfnp&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Valinsky&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2019&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEValinsky2019-219" id="mwBeA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBeE"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBeI">[</span>207<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBeM">]</span></span></a></sup> Opinions about this widespread surveillance range from those who see it as a <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Necessary_evil" title="Necessary evil" id="mwBeQ">necessary evil</a> to those for whom it is clearly <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unethical" title="Unethical" class="mw-redirect" id="mwBeU">unethical</a> and a violation of the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Right_to_privacy" title="Right to privacy" id="mwBeY">right to privacy</a>.<sup about="#mwt794" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991_220-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991-220&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Sfnp&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfnp&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Russell&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Norvig&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2021&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;991&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991-220" id="mwBec"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBeg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBek">[</span>208<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBeo">]</span></span></a></sup></p>
<!-- PRIVACY SOLUTIONS -->

<p id="mwBes">AI developers argue that this is the only way to deliver valuable applications and have developed several techniques that attempt to preserve privacy while still obtaining the data, such as <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_aggregation" title="Data aggregation" id="mwBew">data aggregation</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/De-identification" title="De-identification" id="mwBe0">de-identification</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Differential_privacy" title="Differential privacy" id="mwBe4">differential privacy</a>.<sup about="#mwt797" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991–992_221-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991–992&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991–992-221&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Sfnp&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfnp&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Russell&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Norvig&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2021&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;991–992&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTERussellNorvig2021991–992-221" id="mwBe8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBfA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBfE">[</span>209<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBfI">]</span></span></a></sup> Since 2016, some privacy experts, such as <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynthia_Dwork" title="Cynthia Dwork" id="mwBfM">Cynthia Dwork</a>, have begun to view privacy in terms of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fairness_(machine_learning)" title="Fairness (machine learning)" id="mwBfQ">fairness</a>. <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_Christian" title="Brian Christian" id="mwBfU">Brian Christian</a> wrote that experts have pivoted "from the question of 'what they know' to the question of 'what they're doing with it'."<sup about="#mwt800" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEChristian202063_222-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEChristian202063&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEChristian202063-222&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Sfnp&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfnp&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Christian&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2020&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;63&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEChristian202063-222" id="mwBfY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBfc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBfg">[</span>210<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBfk">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<!-- COPYRIGHT AND GENERATIVE AI -->
<p id="mwBfo">Generative AI is often trained on unlicensed copyrighted works, including in domains such as images or computer code; the output is then used under the rationale of "<a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fair_use" title="Fair use" id="mwBfs">fair use</a>". Experts disagree about how well and under what circumstances this rationale will hold up in courts of law; relevant factors may include "the purpose and character of the use of the copyrighted work" and "the effect upon the potential market for the copyrighted work".<sup about="#mwt803" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEVincent2022_223-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEVincent2022&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEVincent2022-223&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Sfnp&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfnp&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Vincent&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2022&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEVincent2022-223" id="mwBfw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBf0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBf4">[</span>211<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBf8">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt814" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-224" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-224&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-224" id="mwBgA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBgE"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBgI">[</span>212<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBgM">]</span></span></a></sup> Website owners can indicate that they do not want their content scraped via a "<a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robots.txt" title="Robots.txt" id="mwBgQ">robots.txt</a>" file.<sup about="#mwt817" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-225" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-225&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-225" id="mwBgU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBgY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBgc">[</span>213<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBgg">]</span></span></a></sup> However, some companies will scrape content regardless<sup about="#mwt820" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-226" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-226&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-226" id="mwBgk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBgo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBgs">[</span>214<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBgw">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt823" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-227" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-227&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-227" id="mwBg0"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBg4"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBg8">[</span>215<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBhA">]</span></span></a></sup> because the robots.txt file has no real authority. In 2023, leading authors (including <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Grisham" title="John Grisham" id="mwBhE">John Grisham</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonathan_Franzen" title="Jonathan Franzen" id="mwBhI">Jonathan Franzen</a>) sued AI companies for using their work to train generative AI.<sup about="#mwt806" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEReisner2023_228-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" </section><section data-mw-section-id="38" id="mwBiE" aria-labelledby="Dominance_by_tech_giants"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading4"><h4 id="Dominance_by_tech_giants">Dominance by tech giants</h4></div>
<p id="mwBiI">The commercial AI scene is dominated by <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Tech" title="Big Tech" id="mwBiM">Big Tech</a> companies such as <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alphabet_Inc." title="Alphabet Inc." id="mwBiQ">Alphabet Inc.</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_(company)" title="Amazon (company)" id="mwBiU">Amazon</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apple_Inc." title="Apple Inc." id="mwBiY">Apple Inc.</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meta_Platforms" title="Meta Platforms" id="mwBic">Meta Platforms</a>, and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft" title="Microsoft" id="mwBig">Microsoft</a>.<sup about="#mwt829" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-231" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-231&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-231" id="mwBik"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBio"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBis">[</span>219<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBiw">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt832" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-232" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-232&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-232" id="mwBi0"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBi4"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBi8">[</span>220<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBjA">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt835" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-233" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-233&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-233" id="mwBjE"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBjI"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBjM">[</span>221<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBjQ">]</span></span></a></sup> Some of these players already own the vast majority of existing <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cloud_computing" title="Cloud computing" id="mwBjU">cloud infrastructure</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Computing" title="Computing" id="mwBjY">computing</a> power from <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_center" title="Data center" id="mwBjc">data centres</a>, allowing them to entrench further in the marketplace.<sup about="#mwt838" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-234" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-234&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-234" id="mwBjg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBjk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBjo">[</span>222<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBjs">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt841" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-235" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-235&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-235" id="mwBjw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBj0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBj4">[</span>223<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBj8">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBkA">For most of 2025-2026, AI-related companies have dominated stock market returns. Recently, investors have started questioning whether the enormous spending on AI infrastructure and data centers will generate sufficient profits, leading to increased volatility in technology and semiconductor stocks. <sup about="#mwt845" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-236" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-236&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-236" id="mwBkE"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBkI"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBkM">[</span>224<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBkQ">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="39" id="mwBkU" aria-labelledby="Power_needs_and_environmental_impacts"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading4"><h4 id="Power_needs_and_environmental_impacts">Power needs and environmental impacts</h4></div>
